meta.title: Add tail call optimization in VM
meta.body_summary: Implement tail call optimization in the VM by reusing the current frame for immediately returned calls, along with a tail-recursive sum regression test.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added tail call frame reuse in VM with regression test; merged within 22s by author, no human review, no benchmark.

review_details.performance_claim: Tail call optimization reduces stack frame allocations, improving performance for recursive calls by reusing the current frame.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, tail calls are optimized by reusing the current VM frame when a call is immediately returned, eliminating unnecessary frame allocations. Added regression test files (tail_recursion.mochi, tail_recursion.ir.out, tail_recursion.out) to verify correct tail‑recursive execution.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files are part of the regression suite for tail recursion correctness.
